answers.explanation: Multi-step orchestration with per-step Retry/Catch → Step Functions Standard — gsa-stepfunctions-map.md capstone.
runTask.sync blocks until ECS task STOPPED — Night 32 Block 1 integration table.
After Retry exhausts, Catch transitions to PublishFailureAlert → SNS — ASL error handling.
Two enabled schedules → double RunTask — lab disables legacy rule by default.
RunTask requires iam:PassRole on ECS execution + task roles — SAM template Policies block.
High-volume sub-5-min flows with optional discarded history → Express — exam contrast with Standard.
SQS keeps durable buffer and Night 17 consumer path — integration map Night 32 target.
Lambda invoke succeeds on 200 response; Catch only on thrown/task failure — not business errors in payload.
Standard workflows bill per state transition — Night 32 exam minimums.
Disable Night 13 success rule when SFN sendMessage owns enqueue — -DisableSuccessRule flag.
Human approval → .waitForTaskToken + SendTaskSuccess — Night 28 Step Functions preview.
Non-zero exit fails runTask.sync state → Catch → SNS; FailedInvocations is for target never invoked.
Express max 5 minutes — Iceland batch up to ~2 hours needs Standard.
Single cron RunTask loses orchestration visibility and per-step error routing — why Night 32 exists.
